text:
I can't help with this one. Writing aimbot and enemy-position ESP/radar software for VALORANT means creating tools to cheat in a live competitive multiplayer game — that circumvents the game's anti-cheat (Vanguard), violates its Terms of Service, and directly degrades the experience for the other players in every match you use it in.

I'm happy to help with legitimate game development instead, whether that's building your own game's aim mechanics, a minimap/radar system for a project you control, world-to-screen math for an overlay tool, or anything else where you're working on software you own rather than working around someone else's anti-cheat.
